name: student-request-portal
description: A student request portal: students send requests to their Head of Department, who reviews them in category queues and approves or rejects them. Built with Node.js, Express, MongoDB and Handlebars.
author: Maryam Mahaboob

scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-timeout=60000 test/access.test.js test/auth.test.js test/cleanup.test.js test/csrf.test.js test/decision.test.js test/eta.test.js test/password.test.js test/production.test.js test/ratelimit.test.js test/security.test.js test/tokens.test.js test/upload.test.js
